title: The merch on Monday 9 November: Dinis collects it by car from the printer near Lisbon, or the printer delivers?
detail: Silvio has no car, in the Algarve or at Web Summit; Dinis is probably the only one of us with a car in Lisbon. The printer (near Lisbon) is asked for Monday 9 November morning; the first printer is the fallback. Also waiting on Dinis: the /impressao/ files (sleeve logo, lavender hoodie in black ink).
